protocol: Actual RuntimeStopped and actual Circuit natural join are separate prerequisites. The synchronous Slot request requires the real CJoined and NaturalJoin capabilities, same full identity/Gate and original registered writer File before requesting its single worker pause.

The private control is constructed before the real phase worker spawn and retained in the same external Session custody. It is not stored in LiveRoot and cannot form a registry -> consumer -> clock -> registry cycle.

The original phase worker observes the pause only before/after its original 100ms tick, between complete refresh() calls. There is no select around refresh(), original framed read or ConsumerSyncJob. The refresh and synchronization functions are byte-identical.

The original worker moves its own stream, shutdown alias, FenceOnDrop, pre-poll close guard, LiveRoot and WriterCustody into ordered resources. Under the original serial permit, it verifies original Gate/pidfd, stops new consumer admission, sets active=false, intentionally fences the cache and synchronously stores those resources before returning.

The pause waiter captures its already armed owned state before first poll. It borrows the same retained observation JoinHandle and requires actual Returned with no recorded failure; it then joins every retained actual ConsumerSyncJob and requires no failed or missing handle. Zero counters alone do not construct the cap.

Only after those joins may the single parked-resource slot be taken. The private Paused object holds the same stream/alias/guards/File. Its origin checks use sealed original identity, same actual Gate, unchanged absolute ends and original held pidfd; there is no ordinary current() after intentional fencing.

Dropping or cancelling the waiter closes the original Gate. Its actual handle remains in external custody; fault cleanup continues to borrow and join it. Parked resources are discarded only after that actual worker join.

No normal stream-release method or RootIntent constructor is included. Without the actual Root seq1 permission, dropping the Paused or Session remains fault closure. Startup's terminal Err is not changed.
